title: Less, on purpose
sub: Film 1 of Leading a data team, in Leading data people: simpler is better, and it doesn't just happen. List everything the team runs and attends, ask who uses each thing and for what, and stop the rest together, openly and so it can come back. Then measure the time you get back, and protect it.
howto: The film is drawn in ink line, the look of Leading data people: whole people in the places where they live, work and meet, in flat colour with one even dark line, and the film's ideas written by hand, at a board and in notebooks. Its colours mean the same in every film: blue is design and plans (the design principles, the week the team designs, the rule it agrees), orange is data (the pages, the reports and the warehouse's logs), green is value or something done (what people use, the time back), and amber a cost or something waiting (the money spent, the hours in meetings, the alerts that need nothing, a report switched off).
